DEFENDANT SIMPLER POSTAGE DBA EASYPOST IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY JACKSON BAHNS SENIOR ACCOUNTANT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
